import React from "react"

var state:any=0
var data:any={}

function Component(props:any){

  let x:any=1
  let y:any="2"

  function click(){
    eval("console.log('unsafe side effect')")
    state=state+1
    data["last"]=state
  }

  return <div onClick={click}>
    <h1>hello {state}</h1>

    <p>{x+y}</p>

    {true && <span>{"conditional render"}</span>}

    {false ? <div>never</div> : <div>always</div>}

  </div>
}

export default function App(){
  return (
    <div>
      <Component a={1} b={"2"} />

      <Component a={state} b={data} />

      {[1,2,3,4,5].map(function(i:any){
        return <Component key={i} a={i} b={i*i} />
      })}

      {(() => {
        if(state > 5){
          return <div>
            <h2>state too big</h2>
            <button onClick={()=>{
              state=0
              data={}
            }}>reset</button>
          </div>
        }else{
          return <div>
            <h2>ok</h2>
          </div>
        }
      })()}

    </div>
  )
}

class Weird extends React.Component<any,any>{

  constructor(props:any){
    super(props)
    this.state={x:1,y:2}
  }

  render(){
    return <div onMouseMove={(e:any)=>{
      this.setState({x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY})
    }}>
      <h1>{this.state.x + this.state.y}</h1>

      <button onClick={function(){
        console.log("class handler")
        eval("console.log('again unsafe')")
      }}>
        click me
      </button>

      {this.props.children}
    </div>
  }
}

export { Component, Weird }

(globalThis as any)["leakyReact"]=App
